design.purpose: Winter window decoration for home: one 20 cm snowflake

steps.c: Place square flat, fold top-right to bottom-left.
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner.
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut wedge top straight with scissors.
Cut small triangle from left edge.
Cut small triangle from right edge.
Open paper flat to reveal snowflake.
